mapper.update: INSERT INTO commendation (merge_key, date_of_commendation, title, target, category, government_departments, note) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{dateOfCommendation}::date, #{title}, #{target}, #{category}, #{governmentDepartments}, #{note}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO UPDATE SET date_of_commendation = EXCLUDED.date_of_commendation, title = EXCLUDED.title, target = EXCLUDED.target, category = EXCLUDED.category, government_departments = EXCLUDED.government_departments, note = EXCLUDED.note WHERE ( commendation.date_of_commendation, commendation.title, commendation.target, commendation.category, commendation.government_departments, commendation.note ) IS DISTINCT FROM ( EXCLUDED.date_of_commendation, EXCLUDED.title, EXCLUDED.target, EXCLUDED.category, EXCLUDED.government_departments, EXCLUDED.note )

INSERT INTO company_commendation (company_id, commendation_id, inserted_at, deleted) SELECT c.company_id, e.commendation_id, now(), false FROM company c JOIN commendation e ON e.merge_key = #{mergeKey} WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} ON CONFLICT (company_id, commendation_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now() WHERE company_commendation.deleted IS DISTINCT FROM false
UPDATE company_commendation cc SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE cc.deleted = false AND cc.company_id = ( SELECT c.company_id FROM company c WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} )
